title: Ligue 1 top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most Ligue 1 goals from 2000/01 to 2025/26.

notes.Kevin Gameiro: Gameiro is 11th with 101 goals, just outside.
notes.Pauleta: Only goals from 2000/01 count, so his first two Bordeaux seasons are left out.
notes.Sonny Anderson: Anderson scored 48 Ligue 1 goals from 2000/01, most of his goals came earlier.

checks: Totals summed from every Transfermarkt club season page 2000/01 to 2025/26, counted by Transfermarkt player id. Each of the top 16 checked against the Transfermarkt match log (exact match) and against the career statistics table in the player's English Wikipedia article (season by season). All agree except Gignac: Wikipedia has 9 goals in 2010/11, Transfermarkt 8, so 103 or 102. Either way he is in the top ten (9th or level with Payet in 8th). Gameiro is 101 on both.
